"""RoboPaint-strict episode controller for the `in unum` exemplar.
All coordinates are metres in the service world frame. The sheet-plane transforms are
from the calibrated overhead camera and the static paper-frame definition.
"""
import math
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

# Sheet scale and paper origins derived from the overhead camera view.
MM = 0.22186
MAIN_YW_LEFT = 0.11359        # world y at main paper X=0
MAIN_XW_FAR = 0.01359         # world x at main paper Y=0
PAPER_Z = 0.0200
CONTACT_Z = 0.0160
CLEAR_Z = 0.0950
Q_DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])

def quat_edge_angle(phi):
    """Pen pointing down; nib edge has world XY angle phi from +world-x."""
    th = phi + math.pi/2
    return np.array([0., math.cos(th/2), math.sin(th/2), 0.])

def slerp(a, b, t):
    a = np.asarray(a, float); b = np.asarray(b, float)
    d = float(np.dot(a,b))
    if d < 0: b = -b; d = -d
    d = min(1., max(-1., d))
    if d > .9995:
        q = a + t*(b-a); return q/np.linalg.norm(q)
    th = math.acos(d); return math.sin((1-t)*th)/math.sin(th)*a + math.sin(t*th)/math.sin(th)*b

def target_xyz(paper_x_mm, paper_y_mm, z):
    # Exemplar paper X points to robot-right = -world y; paper Y points toward robot = -world x.
    return np.array([MAIN_XW_FAR - paper_y_mm/1000.,
                     MAIN_YW_LEFT - paper_x_mm/1000., z], float)

def submit_rows(r, rows, label=""):
    rows=np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32)
    if len(rows)==0: return
    res=r.submit("ee_pose",rows,dt=.05,video="none",note=label)
    plan=res.meta.get("plan",[])
    fails=sum(int(x.get("ik_failures",0)) for x in plan)
    slow=sum(bool(x.get("slowed",False)) for x in plan)
    print(label,"rows",len(rows),"ik_failures",fails,"slowed",slow,"stopped",res.stopped)
    if res.stopped: raise RuntimeError("service stopped call: "+str(res.stopped))

def move_to(r, state, xyz, q=None, label="move"):
    """Small, slow straight-line move from the previous ee target; state is [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz]."""
    xyz=np.asarray(xyz,float); q=state[3:7].copy() if q is None else np.asarray(q,float)
    p0=state.copy(); dist=np.linalg.norm(xyz-p0[:3])
    dot=abs(float(np.dot(p0[3:7]/np.linalg.norm(p0[3:7]),q/np.linalg.norm(q))))
    ang=2*math.acos(min(1.,dot))
    n=max(1,int(math.ceil(dist/.006)),int(math.ceil(ang/.10)))
    rows=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        t=i/n; rows.append(np.r_[p0[:3]+t*(xyz-p0[:3]),slerp(p0[3:7],q,t)])
    submit_rows(r,rows,label)
    state[:3]=xyz; state[3:7]=q/np.linalg.norm(q)
    return state

def dwell(r, state, n, label="dwell"):
    submit_rows(r,np.tile(state,(n,1)),label)
    return state

def stroke_polyline(r, state, xyz_points, q, z_contact=CONTACT_Z, label="stroke"):
    """Lift, set down, trace a centreline slowly, lift; one continuous contact."""
    pts=[np.asarray(p,float) for p in xyz_points]
    q=np.asarray(q,float); q=q/np.linalg.norm(q)
    state=move_to(r,state,[pts[0][0],pts[0][1],CLEAR_Z],q,label+" approach")
    state=move_to(r,state,[pts[0][0],pts[0][1],z_contact],q,label+" set-down")
    # Resample each segment to <= 3 mm, with a target every 50 ms.
    for a,b in zip(pts[:-1],pts[1:]):
        dist=np.linalg.norm(b-a); n=max(1,int(math.ceil(dist/.003)))
        rows=[]
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            t=i/n; rows.append(np.r_[a+t*(b-a),q])
        submit_rows(r,rows,label+" trace")
    state=np.r_[pts[-1],q]
    state=move_to(r,state,[pts[-1][0],pts[-1][1],CLEAR_Z],q,label+" lift")
    return state

def paper_stroke(r, state, coords_px, edge_phi, label):
    pts=[target_xyz((u+.5)*MM,(v+.5)*MM,CONTACT_Z) for u,v in coords_px]
    return stroke_polyline(r,state,pts,quat_edge_angle(edge_phi),label=label)

# Episode calls are added below as the practice sheet establishes mark width.
def run_practice():
    r=Robot()
    obs=r.get_obs(video="none")
    state=np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14],float)
    print("start",r.status(),"pose",state)
    # Ink well centre measured from scene-camera depth; its ink surface is z ~= 0.0285 m.
    well=np.array([-.1005,.1490])
    state=move_to(r,state,[well[0],well[1],.11],Q_DOWN,"above ink well")
    state=move_to(r,state,[well[0],well[1],.026],Q_DOWN,"dip")
    state=dwell(r,state,12,"ink dip dwell")
    state=move_to(r,state,[well[0],well[1],CLEAR_Z],Q_DOWN,"leave well")
    # Three short calibration marks on practice: edge tangent, 30 degrees from tangent, perpendicular.
    x0,x1=-.113,-.088
    for idx,(y,phi) in enumerate([(-.210,0.),(-.185,math.radians(30)),(-.160,math.pi/2)]):
        q=quat_edge_angle(phi)
        state=stroke_polyline(r,state,[[x0,y,CONTACT_Z],[x1,y,CONTACT_Z]],q,label=f"practice width {idx}")
    print("practice done",r.status())
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam","canvas_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"],video="none")
    from PIL import Image
    for cam,im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/practice_{cam}.png")

if __name__=="__main__":
    run_practice()

+def thin_binary(mask):
+    """Zhang-Suen thinning, used to obtain a single centreline network per glyph."""
+    x=np.pad(mask.astype(np.uint8),1)

+    for _ in range(100):

+        for phase in range(2):
+            p=neighbors(x); c=x[1:-1,1:-1]
+            count=sum(p)
+            transitions=sum(((p[i]==0)&(p[(i+1)%8]==1)).astype(np.uint8) for i in range(8))
+            remove=(c==1)&(count>=2)&(count<=6)&(transitions==1)

+            c[remove]=0; changed+=int(remove.sum())

+def exemplar_routes(path="/app/target.png"):
+    """Return smoothed, resampled centreline walks for the six bodies and i dot."""

+        sk=thin_binary(component)

+        nodes=set(zip(yy.tolist(),xx.tolist()))
+        graph={p:[] for p in nodes}
+        for y,x in nodes:
